articles.title: Strong Solar Flare
articles.summary: This Feb. 4, 2026, image from NASA’s Solar Dynamics Observatory (SDO) captures a strong solar flare erupting from the star. Solar flares are powerful bursts of energy that can, along with other types of solar eruptions, can impact radio communications, electric power grids, navigation signals, and pose risks to spacecraft and astronauts. articles.title: Boreal Forests Are Shifting North
articles.summary: The boreal forest—the world’s largest terrestrial biome—is warming faster than any other forest type. New research uses Landsat data to track how the forests shift.

articles.title: ‘We helped usher in the modern era of AI in NGA.’
articles.summary:
